description: Walk-forward validation, out-of-sample testing, and regime-aware robustness framework. Implements the validation pipeline that separates surviving hypotheses into those with genuine predictive power vs those that are overfit or regime-dependent.
steps: Create src/quant_research/validation/walk_forward.py - WalkForwardValidator class: implements expanding-window and rolling-window walk-forward analysis, configurable train/test split ratios (default 80/20 with 5 folds), for each fold: train signal parameters on in-sample, test on out-of-sample, tracks performance stability across folds (Sharpe, hit rate, expectancy per fold), rejects hypotheses where out-of-sample performance degrades >50% vs in-sample, computes consistency ratio (fraction of folds with positive expectancy), requires consistency ratio >= 0.6 to pass

Create src/quant_research/validation/out_of_sample.py - OutOfSampleValidator class: reserves final 20% of data as pure holdout (never touched during development), runs surviving hypotheses on holdout data, computes performance metrics on holdout, applies stricter thresholds on holdout (p < 0.01, Sharpe > 0.4), computes decay analysis (is the edge weakening over time?), tests hypothesis across different market regimes identified in the data

Create src/quant_research/robustness/regime_analysis.py - RegimeAnalyzer class: identifies market regimes using HMM or simple vol/trend classification (bull trending, bear trending, sideways/choppy, high-vol crisis), tests each surviving hypothesis within each regime, flags hypotheses that only work in one regime, computes regime-conditional Sharpe ratios, reports which hypotheses are regime-robust vs regime-dependent

Create src/quant_research/robustness/transaction_costs.py - TransactionCostModel class: models realistic transaction costs (commission: $0.005/share, spread: configurable by vol regime from 0.01% to 0.05%, slippage: function of volume and trade size, market impact: square-root model for position sizing), applies costs to strategy returns, rejects hypotheses where edge disappears after costs, reports net Sharpe and net expectancy after costs

Create src/quant_research/validation/pipeline.py - ValidationPipeline class that orchestrates the full flow: takes list of hypotheses that passed initial statistical testing, runs walk-forward validation -> reject failures, runs out-of-sample validation -> reject failures, runs regime analysis -> flag regime-dependent ones, applies transaction costs -> reject unprofitable after costs, returns final list of validated hypotheses with full statistics

Create tests/test_validation.py - Test WalkForwardValidator with synthetic data (known trending signal should pass, random noise should fail), test OutOfSampleValidator, test RegimeAnalyzer correctly identifies regimes, test TransactionCostModel correctly reduces returns, test ValidationPipeline end-to-end with mock hypotheses
Run pytest to verify all tests pass
acceptance_criteria: WalkForwardValidator correctly implements expanding-window walk-forward with configurable folds
OutOfSampleValidator reserves holdout data and applies stricter thresholds
RegimeAnalyzer identifies at least 3 distinct market regimes from historical data
TransactionCostModel includes commission, spread, slippage, and market impact
ValidationPipeline correctly chains all validation steps and produces a filtered list of surviving hypotheses
Hypotheses based on noise/random signals are reliably rejected by the pipeline
